mapper.select:
select t.* from ( select a.id as mainId, a.client_id as clientId, cl.client_name as clientName, a.proj_name as projName, a.contract_code as contractCode, a.create_time as createTime, a.actual_lease_date as actualLeaseDate, b.earliest_pay_date as earliestPayDate, b.total_pay_amount as totalPay, ifnull(c.total_plan_rent,0) as totalPlanRent, ifnull(c.total_collection_rent,0) as totalCollectionRent, ifnull(c.total_plan_principal,0) as totalPlanPrincipal, ifnull(c.total_collection_principal,0) as totalCollectionPrincipal, ifnull(c.total_plan_interest,0) as totalPlanInterest, ifnull(c.total_collection_interest,0) as totalCollectionInterest, ifnull(d.collection_amount,0) as earnestBalance, ifnull(e.plan_collection_first_rent,0) as planCollectionFirstRent, ifnull(e.collection_first_rent,0) as collectionFirstRent, case a.biz_type when 'ZR' then cap.aoc_credit_term when 'BL' then cfp.factoring_credit_term else clp.lease_month_count end as leaseDuration, case a.biz_type when 'ZR' then cap.irr_percent when 'BL' then cfp.irr_percent else clp.irr_percent end as estimateIrr, cci.risk_control_industry_classify as riskControlIndustryClassifyCode, it.code as industryCode, it.display as industryDisplay, a.biz_type as bizTypeCode, a.biz_dept_id as bizDeptId, a.proj_sponsor_user_id as projSponsorUserId, a.risk_control_manager_id as risk_control_manager_id, a.proj_cosponsor_user_ids as projCosponsorUserIdsJson from contract_base_info as a inner join (select contract_id, sum(paid_in_amount) as total_pay_amount, max(paid_in_date) as earliest_pay_date from payment_actual_detail group by contract_id having total_pay_amount > 0) as b on a.id = b.contract_id left join ( select contract_id, sum(collection_amount) as total_collection_rent, sum(plan_collection_amount) as total_plan_rent, sum(collection_interest) as total_collection_interest, sum(interest) as total_plan_interest, sum(collection_principal) as total_collection_principal, sum(principal) as total_plan_principal from collection_base_info where cash_flow_item = 'RENT' and phase > 0 group by contract_id ) as c on a.id = c.contract_id left join (select contract_id, sum(collection_amount) as collection_first_rent, sum(plan_collection_amount) as plan_collection_first_rent from collection_base_info where cash_flow_item = 'FIRST_RENT' group by contract_id) as e on a.id = e.contract_id left join margin_base_info as d on a.id = d.contract_id left join contract_lease_price as clp on a.id = clp.contract_id left join contract_factoring_price as cfp on a.id = cfp.contract_id left join contract_aoc_price as cap on a.id = cap.contract_id left join client as cl on a.client_id = cl.id left join corp_commerce_info as cci on cl.id = cci.client_id left join industry_type as it on substr(cci.industry_type,1,1) = it.code and it.level = 1 ) as t where ((totalPay > (totalCollectionPrincipal + collectionFirstRent)) or (earnestBalance > 0))
and t.contractCode like concat('%', #{contractCode}, '%')
and t.projName like concat('%', #{projName},'%')
and #{rentBalanceFrom} <= (t.totalPlanRent - t.totalCollectionRent)
and #{rentBalanceTo} >= (t.totalPlanRent - t.totalCollectionRent)
and t.bizDeptId in
#{item}
and ( t.projSponsorUserId = #{authCurrentUserId} or json_contains(t.projCosponsorUserIdsJson, cast( #{authCurrentUserId} as json) ) )
and t.risk_control_manager_id = #{accountVO.id}
and t.clientId = #{clientId}
order by createTime desc
